title: 10,000 Small Businesses in the United Kingdom: Goldman Sachs
description: The Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses program in the UK is designed to provide high-quality, practical education and business support to leaders of high-growth small businesses and social enterprises as they navigate barriers to growth and unlock the economic and job creation potential.  Learn More about the program: http://www.goldmansachs.com/citizenship/10000-small-businesses/UK/index.htmltial of their businesses.

asr.full_text: Being a small business owner in the UK is tough. It's a very lonely, lonely place, being an owner of a business, particularly a growing business. You're the leader in the business, you don't often get the time to step back and reflect but it's important. Any business can grow provided you're willing to adapt and change your ideas. How can a robot business and a cleaning business and a haulage business and a restaurant have similar problems? All of the other people in the room were facing exactly the same challenges as myself and that in itself was just a really nice feeling. The Goldman Sachs 10,000 small business program is half a day a week over a 12 week period. For me it was an opportunity to sit down and look at the fundamental software business. Yes you've got world class tutors there and yes you've got fantastic guest speakers from all walks of life. It was the peer to peer learning that put everything into context Financing accounts General better HR practice Mitigating risks Sales and marketing What was the plan? You form a growth plan during the programme and you go away and start applying it and making a massive impact on the business The business grew because I took the time out of the business to think about it learn and come back with new ideas and new skills and transfer them to my colleagues. I think without the 10,000 Small Businesses Programme I'd still be bogged down in the day-to-day running of the business rather than looking at how to make the business better and bigger. The programme really does not end after the twelve modules in fact that's when it all starts. Now that a network of other businesses who are of the same mindset as you. It's like a quality mark." Gia-Luz Martin -"This network is absolutely fantastic. It means that what you've learned already can be developed upon." It's proved to be a very valuable trading fraternity." We shucked about. It's not that we're buying directly into the Alumni Network but they're providing me the best service, I have trust, I have good price and I have longevity. I think Goldman Sachs have formulated the program mixing together social enterprise with commercial businesses. We can learn from each other. We had a need to increase our capacity for outwork. We've now worked with social enterprise to employ ten people who've never had a job before and that is a heck of a good feeling. Small businesses are at the heart of Community and therefore as we grow then the community benefits as well. Growth in small enterprises is really important for the UK economy. Since the programme we've gained some really really prestigious accounts. The growth that we've experienced has been phenomenal. We've been lucky enough to achieve more than 100% year on year. We've increased from 19 staff 15 months ago to 29 staff as we are today. We go from 40 cover restaurant to 65 cover restaurant. Instead of taking 29 minutes to process an order, it now takes less than 2 minutes. Since 10,000 small businesses, we've grown already by over 30%. Over the next 2 years, we will grow again and double in size. That growth wouldn't have come without the help we had from the programme.

textual.context: Promotional or testimonial context for a business education/support program; the source attributes growth statements to program participants, but the supplied records do not show whether the speaker is making a guaranteed outcome claim.
textual.potential_relevance: A measurable growth/return claim is linked to the program and a requested navigation action to learn more about it, which may require later context assessment of conditions, substantiation and audience action path.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish fees, application requirements, eligibility decisions, actual enrollment flow, verified business results, or whether the URL destination matches the described program.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses as a UK program offering practical education and business support through growth planning and applying ideas. The interview-style participant testimonials and invitation to learn more through a program link are framed as educational and support-related rather than as a deceptive financial solicitation or required investment flow.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central subject is practical business education, peer learning, growth planning and operational support, which fits education and operational demonstration content. The records do not establish a scam mechanism.
